iVANKY 26-in-1 Thunderbolt 5 FusionDock Ultra now $150 off for Black Friday

iVANKY’s Thunderbolt 5 FusionDock Ultra has dropped to its very best price of the year at $599.99 exclusively via the brand’s official site and over on Amazon using code 9TO5MAC for Black Friday 2026 (also available on Amazon UK at £599.99 with no coded needed). That’s $150 off and $50 under the next best price of 2026. If you’re looking to setup a powerful workstation or upgrade your existing rig, the 26-port FusionDock Ultra is specifically designed to elevate demanding Apple Silicon Mac workstations with support for up to four native 6K displays, 140W charging, 10Gb Ethernet, and a combination of dual-chip architecture and active cooling for stable, dependable performance – scope out our hands-on review for a closer look. If the FusionDock Ultra is a bit overkill for you, the FusionDock Max 2 is a more affordable alternative that still delivers the Thunderbolt 5 and multi-display connectivity you need for a capable Mac workstation – it’s now down at $359.99 from the regular $449.99 for Black Friday.

  • iVANKY FusionDock Ultra $600 ($150 off)

The best robotic cleaners you can buy: Roborock’s 2026 lineup drops to best prices ever at up to $1,610 off for Black Friday

If you’re looking to upgrade your setup with a robotic cleaning system, amzn.to/4zoTSFl should be your first choice – its models are easily some of the best out there and you can now score giant Black Friday deals at up to $1,610 off its ultra-intelligent 2026 releases. Whether it’s the flagship Saros 20 bot with StarSight navigation tech and wildly powerful 36,000 Pa suction, or a much more affordable variant that still delivers whole home mopping and cleaning, the brand has something for anyone’s needs and now at some of the lowest prices of the year.

Libernovo ergonomic and powered AirFlow desk chairs up to $884 off for Black Friday

Everyone should be investing in a proper, reliable desk chair – Libernovo delivers some of the best ergonomic solutions you can buy for your setup and it is now running its biggest sale of the year for Black Friday 2026 from November 19 through the 26th. Spread across both its ergonomic Maxis and Omni lineups, you’re looking at massive deals here at up to $884 off on both its manual chairs and the electric models with powered airflow and adjustment. All of them can be purchased in standard configurations or with an included footrest and extra battery on the electric and AirFlow models, and all of them have hit some of the lowest prices of the year:

  • Maxis Manual from $849 (Up to $579 off)
  • Maxis Electric or AirFlow from $1,099 (Up to $884 off)
  • Omni SE from $609 (Up to $290 off)
  • Omni Pro from $919 (Up to $549 off)

***All orders include 30-day price protection and you’ll find bundle options with a FREE mouse pad on orders of $800 or more, and a three piece gift set on $1,000+ orders, as well as a neck pillow, eye mask, and noise-reducing earplugs with purchases of $1,200 or more.
